incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: customer=amberstream (single-tenant) p99 latency breach detected in hosted region us-west-2. Alert rule: streaming_tail_p99 > 2s for 5m. Triggered at 2026-03-15T18:40:34Z

incident-bot: Metrics snapshot: p95=420ms (baseline 120ms), p99=3.9s (baseline 450ms), error rate 0.8% (unchanged). Streaming stalls observed: 12% of active streams reporting >5s token gaps.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Paging @eng-ryan and @eng-runtime. Any known deploys?

eng-ryan: no deploys from runtime in last 30m. Seeing a spike in long-prefix requests from AmberStream — lots of 8k+ token conversations starting.

support-ella: Customer reports intermittent stalls in their UI, users seeing responses hang for ~6-8s then resume. They say it started ~18:35UTC. Impacting roughly 8-12% of their requests.

eng-runtime: Looking at serving metrics: per-worker queue depth increased on dedicated pool amberstream-01. KV cache hit rate dropped from 78% -> 34% for that tenant. Likely cache eviction thrash due to many different long prefixes.

eng-ryan: Reproduced locally with long prompt set: streaming stalls when sequence length + attention windows cause frequent cache misses and heavy KV writes. Potential hotspot around prefix shard eviction and async popstream backpressure.

eng-runtime: Dumping logs from stream-proxy on amberstream-01:
```
2026-03-15T18:37:02Z INFO popstream: enqueue request id=abc123 prefix_len=4096 tokens=6200
2026-03-15T18:37:03Z WARN kvcache: eviction rate spike tenant=amberstream rate=18/s
2026-03-15T18:37:05Z ERROR streamer: stall detected token_gap_ms=5500 id=abc123
2026-03-15T18:37:07Z INFO fallback: routing to model-small variant id=def456
```

eng-ryan: Hypothesis: single-tenant workload with many unique long prefixes causing KV cache thrash -> async batcher stalls -> tail latency spikes. Also seeing fallback routing kicks which increases CPU on small variant and amplifies latency.

sre-oncall: Mitigation plan (immediate):
- 1) Increase KV cache size for amberstream-01 pool by +25% (temp).
- 2) Enable prefix canonicalization for that tenant (dedupe similar prompts) via routing rule.
- 3) Temporarily divert 10% of AmberStream traffic to fallback pool in another AZ to reduce local pressure.
- 4) If stalls persist, enable streaming backpressure heuristics to shed highest-latency sessions.

eng-runtime: Applying step 1 now: PATCH pool config amberstream-01 kv_cache_max=1.25x -> rolling restart will apply.

eng-ryan: Enabling prefix canonicalization rule (dry-run first). Pattern: if prompt_length>2048 and repeats>3 -> canonicalize tokens. Pushing canary to 10% of tenant traffic.

pm-alex: Noted customer comms: support-ella looped AmberStream engineering; they're prepared for a brief failover. Please update me before we do any global changes.

sre-oncall: Rolling restart started on amberstream-01 worker-3 (kv resize applied). Monitoring logs and p99.

incident-bot: change: pool-config-update by eng-runtime at 2026-03-15T18:42:10Z

eng-runtime: After kv resize p99 improved from 3.9s -> 1.6s within ~70s on the restarted worker. But other workers still showing 2.2-4.0s.

eng-ryan: Canary prefix-canonicalization at 10% shows 60% reduction in stalls for affected requests. Rolling to 30% now.

support-ella: AmberStream engineering confirms UI errors dropped once you started the restart; they see far fewer hangs. They're still seeing some sessions stall when hitting very long histories.

eng-runtime: Diverting 10% traffic to amberstream-failover-AZ completed. Observed p99 in AZ B is stable ~420ms. Overall global p99 now 1.1s.

sre-oncall: Good. Next steps: keep canonicalization at 30% for 15m, monitor KV eviction rate and p99. If stable, increase to 60% and then full roll.

eng-ryan: Also adding a short-term config to bump batcher token timeout from 50ms -> 80ms to reduce premature stalls; testing on canary.

incident-bot: customer-impact: AmberStream reported degraded UX 18:35-18:47UTC affecting ~10% of requests, mostly long conversations (>4k tokens). No error rate spike or data loss.

pm-alex: Please schedule a post-incident review tomorrow 10:30PT to discuss longer-term mitigations: smarter prefix canonicalization, tenant-specific cache sizing, and adaptive routing policies.

sre-oncall: Handoff to night SRE (eng-ryan) at 19:00UTC. If p99 > 2s or stall rate >5% re-open paging.

eng-ryan: I'm taking overnight. Current status: mitigation applied, p99 trending -> 600ms, stalls -> 2.1%. Will follow up with a timeline for full remediation (likely a config change + capacity bump).

support-ella: I updated AmberStream: we applied temporary mitigations, you should see improvement. We're scheduling follow-up with your team for long-term changes.

eng-runtime: Added monitoring dashboard panel for tenant-specific kv_eviction, prefix_uniqueness_score, and stream_stall_rate. Alerts adjusted to suppress noisy transient spikes during rolling config changes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T18:50:00Z — continue monitoring.

eng-ryan: Leaving final note: action items created: CID-1029 (tenant cache sizing), CID-1030 (prefix canonicalization tuning), CID-1031 (adaptive routing playbook). Handoff complete. :thumbsup:

support-ella: thanks team, good work.
